* Cultures that value directness: 
  • Germany, where criticism is often seen as a constructive way to improve relationships
  • Sweden, where straightforward communication is considered important for building trust
* Cultures that value tact:
  • Japan, where indirect comments are used to avoid hurting others' feelings
  • many African cultures, where criticism is often reserved for private conversations to maintain social harmony
